head: 2f91218e71dbcaf94ea7b454a0e3562800bfe601
scope: Confirmed non-Support member-web failures from first discovery pass. No production fixes applied. Severity is repair priority, not a vulnerability score.

issues.title: Failed privacy-word reads permit replacing existing filters
issues.expected: Unknown initial settings must not be treated as an empty confirmed list; adding a word must preserve existing filters.
issues.actual: Both resolved read errors and rejected reads leave an empty editable list. Add sends a profiles update with only ["newword"] and renders that one word. The simulated stored baseline contains "existing".
issues.reproduction: Load with profiles read failing, enter newword, click Add; inspect the exact update array.
issues.limits: Actual frozen components in Chromium with controlled synthetic responses; no real provider writes or hosted reproduction claimed.

issues.title: Account standing reports a clean record after failed lookup
issues.expected: Failed or unavailable strike data should remain unknown with a recovery action.
issues.actual: Resolved member_strikes error renders “Good standing. No strikes on this account.” Rejection emits an uncaught error and leaves Loading.
issues.reproduction: Return an error or reject the member_strikes read while identity succeeds.
issues.limits: Actual frozen components in Chromium with controlled synthetic responses; no real provider writes or hosted reproduction claimed.

issues.title: Explore can remain Loading after one rejected feed read
issues.expected: A failed section should expose recovery and settle the page loading state.
issues.actual: A rejected get_feed inside Promise.all produces an uncaught rejection; loaded never becomes true. Resolved errors silently omit failed content.
issues.reproduction: Keep authentication/trending normal and reject only get_feed.
issues.limits: Actual frozen components in Chromium with controlled synthetic responses; no real provider writes or hosted reproduction claimed.

issues.title: Topic reads confuse failure with an empty topic or never settle
issues.expected: A failed topic read should be distinguished from an empty successful response.
issues.actual: With the correct Promise params, a returned posts error renders “No posts with this topic yet.” A rejection leaves Loading and is uncaught.
issues.limits: Actual frozen components in Chromium with controlled synthetic responses; no real provider writes or hosted reproduction claimed.

issues.title: Empty-query Search becomes blank when trending topics fail
issues.expected: Unavailable discovery content should provide a meaningful state or recovery action.
issues.actual: The page main content is empty when get_trending_topics errors; rejected requests are uncaught. Existing real AppShell is outside this fixture, so this is not a claim that the full hosted app loses its navigation.
issues.reproduction: Open Search with no query and fail only get_trending_topics.
issues.limits: Actual frozen components in Chromium with controlled synthetic responses; no real provider writes or hosted reproduction claimed.

issues.title: Creation forms remain busy after rejected requests
issues.expected: Unexpected failures should release the submit lock, retain input and show an error.
issues.actual: A rejected listing upload or insert leaves Publishing disabled. A rejected create-business invocation leaves Creating disabled. Standard returned-error paths correctly restore the buttons.
issues.reproduction: Fill a valid synthetic form; reject the indicated upload/insert/function request; compare with returned-error controls.
issues.limits: Actual frozen components in Chromium with controlled synthetic responses; no real provider writes or hosted reproduction claimed.

issues.title: Promotion picker hides its content-load failure
issues.expected: A failed existing-content read should be visible in the picker with recovery.
issues.actual: The catch records an error, but it is rendered only in step4. At step2 the user sees format/new-text choices and no existing posts or failure explanation.
issues.reproduction: Fail the posts read, choose Get more views, click Continue.
issues.limits: Actual frozen components in Chromium with controlled synthetic responses; no real provider writes or hosted reproduction claimed.

issues.title: Auxiliary discovery and inbox reads reject without handlers
issues.expected: Ancillary failures must be handled without uncaught rejections and without claiming a known badge/list state.
issues.actual: MarketUnreadDot lets loadConversations reject; FeaturedChannels/ExploreTopics reject unhandled; the new-listing feature-flag read also rejects unhandled. Main Market and Discover error/retry paths remain functional.
issues.reproduction: Fail conversations/get_channels/get_trending_topics/feature_flags independently or inspect the route rejected-mode record.
issues.limits: Actual frozen components in Chromium with controlled synthetic responses; no real provider writes or hosted reproduction claimed.

issues.title: Profile photo row intercepts the cover-change button center
issues.expected: Visible cover controls should receive normal pointer input.
issues.actual: At1440px and390px, elementFromPoint at the Change cover button center returns the overlapping photoRow. A normal click times out on pointer interception. Source has bottom15px cover controls and a later positioned photoRow with margin-top:-35px.
issues.reproduction: Open the actual Profile editor and click Change cover at its center; inspect hit target and geometry.
issues.limits: Actual component and CSS at desktop/mobile widths, with synthetic profile data. The fixture does not include the full AppShell; intrinsic overlapping row geometry is retained. No forced clicks were used.

additionalAccessibilityObservation.observation: Actual deployed signed-out AX exposes two unnamed text fields; DOM controls rely on placeholders and have no aria-label. Signup AX likewise has unnamed inputs.
additionalAccessibilityObservation.boundary: Keep separate from the nine behavior families until exact accessible-name behavior across supported screen readers is checked.
